text: Program Description The program is aimed at providing international students with the curricula and fundamental knowledge of Chinese literature, cultural teaching, research and international exchanges, and developing their creativity, enthusiasm and international horizon. Courses: Intensive Chinese, History of Chinese Culture, History of Chinese Literature, Chinese Words and Culture, Readings of Chinese Classic Literature, Readings of Chinese Modern Literature. Core Courses: History of Chinese Modern Literature, History of Chinese Poetry, History of Chinese Aesthetics, Classic Chinese Prose, The Analects and Chinese Culture, Laozi and Chinese Philosophy, Chinese Modern Fiction and Chinese Modern Poetry.
